title: Password Generator
seoTitle: Free Password Generator — Secure Random Passwords
description: Generate strong, random passwords with custom length and character sets. Runs entirely in your browser for privacy.
intro: Choose length and character types. Click generate for a secure password you can copy.
blurb: Create strong random passwords with adjustable length and character options.
howItWorks: Set the desired password length (8–64 characters).
Select which character types to include.
Click Generate Password. A cryptographically strong random password is created locally.
examples: 16 characters with upper, lower, numbers produces something like K7mP2qR9xL4nB8wY.
Include symbols for higher entropy: aB3$kL9!mN2p.
Shorter passwords are faster to type but less secure.

faq.q: Is the password stored or sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. Generation uses the browser's crypto.getRandomValues and never leaves your device.
With mixed characters and length 16+, they are highly resistant to brute-force attacks.
Yes. Click Generate again for a new one each time.
